title.narrative: Initiation Plan (IP) för Uppskalning av LoGIC

description.narrative:
The overall objective of LoGIC is: Improved and inclusive local level planning and a strengthened financing mechanism for community-based climate change adaptation solutions through local governments.
The purpose of the Initiation Plan (IP) Phase is to support the Local Government Division (LGD) of the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development & Cooperatives and the External Relations Division (ERD) of the Ministry of Finance to transition the LoGIC model to a national scale-up via an innovative financing approach and facility using both loans and grants.
The main outputs of the IP during the 12 months are:
1. Technical assistance to Local Government Divison (LGD) and External Relations Division (ERD) to mobilize concessional loans and grants from MDBs and development partners, develop key documents and financial proposals, and catalyze cross ministerial coordination for locally-led adaptation.
2. Strengthening of climate-resilient cooperatives and youth- and women-led green enterprises, linking to market systems through value chain development and engagement of the private sector.
3. Operationalization of tools like the Climate Vulnerability Index (CVI) and Local Adaptation Plan of Action (LAPA) across ministries.
4. Design of a blended financing mechanism to mobilize private sector investment for local climate adaptation and Nature-based Solution (NbS) investments, leveraging innovative financial instruments and strategic partnerships.
5. An enhanced performance-based climate resilience grant (PBCRG) system which enables incorporating climate adaptation and resilience considerations into national and local planning, budgeting and monitoring processes.
6. Climate risk insurance mechanisms and financial protection instruments developed and institutionalised into local adaptation frameworks to safeguard public and private investments while de-risking and attracting private finance.
